name: CaptureRouteMinimap
intent: A floating, resizable, collapsible mini-viewer that overlays a main view with a whole floor plan and a blue capture walk of ordered points. Minimizes to a map-icon button and fires onPointSelect when a point is clicked.
when: Overlaying an ordered capture walk-through route on a map / blueprint view
A collapsible floor-plan overview with clickable capture points

chooseOver.because: CaptureRouteMinimap draws an ordered capture route with selectable points; MapMinimap is a plain viewport overview of the current view

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation
